permitted_customer_action: Reset AC by turning off MCB for 3 minutes. If error returns, book professional service. Do NOT open the casing.
technician_action: Check resistance of indoor air sensor (5kΩ-10kΩ at 25°C). Check PCB connector CN-TH1.

permitted_customer_action: Reset AC via main switch. Do not attempt to dismantle indoor casing.
technician_action: Measure pipe inlet sensor resistance. Verify sensor is properly clipped to copper pipe.

permitted_customer_action: Check if outdoor unit power cord is secure and MCB is on. Do NOT touch terminal block or high voltage lines. If error persists, book certified technician.
technician_action: Check continuity of communication wire (F1/F2 or L1/L2). Check terminal block tightness. Test PCB signal output.
note: Verified in official lookup; has no dedicated interactive decision tree flow in AC03. Returning verified customer action without fabricating an unverified tree flow.

permitted_customer_action: Check external drain hose outlet for kinks, kinks or water submergence. Do NOT disassemble internal drain pump.
technician_action: Test drain pump operation. Check float switch continuity. Clear drain line obstruction.
note: Verified in official lookup; has no dedicated branch in AC03. Returning verified customer action.

permitted_customer_action: Turn OFF main MCB breaker for 3 minutes, then turn back ON. If CH 05 returns immediately, stop and schedule technician.
technician_action: Check DC voltage between L1-L2 (should fluctuate 0-24V). Inspect wiring for cuts. Replace Indoor PCB first, then Outdoor PCB.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC unit immediately at the MCB breaker to prevent electrical or motor burn. Do not restart without verification from a certified technician.
technician_action: Verify model service manual. Check both outdoor BLDC fan motor resistance AND outdoor pipe thermistor reading.

conflict_details.diagnostic_tree_definition: Outdoor Fan / Pipe Temperature Sensor Error
conflict_details.resolution_requirement: Exact error meaning differs between models. Must be verified against model-specific wiring diagram and service manual UW-Q18WUZA vs MS-Q18YNZA.

permitted_customer_action: Ensure all indoor units are set to the same operating mode (all Cool or all Heat). Mixed modes trigger this error code.
technician_action: Verify DIP switch settings on outdoor PCB match installation type. Reset system.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC immediately. Book technician visit to inspect indoor fan blower motor.
technician_action: Check blower wheel for debris. Measure BLDC motor feedback signal. Test indoor PCB fan driver.

permitted_customer_action: Power cycle unit via MCB for 5 minutes. If code returns, book technician for PCB firmware / EEPROM check.
technician_action: Inspect PCB EEPROM chip and reprogram option code if applicable.
note: Present in AC03 tree but absent from official error code lookup. Unverified pending model manual validation.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC power immediately at the MCB. Do NOT touch internal components. Water overflow or motor lockout requires professional attention.
technician_action: Inspect both indoor blower wheel free spin AND drain pan float switch depending on indoor chassis model.

conflict_details.lookup_definition: Indoor Unit Drain Level High (Water Overflow Risk / Float Switch)
conflict_details.diagnostic_tree_definition: Indoor Blower Fan Motor Locked (BLDC Hall Sensor / Jammed Fan)
conflict_details.resolution_requirement: In ceiling cassette and certain commercial units CH 10 is Float Switch/Drain Level; in standard wall-mount residential units CH 10 often designates Indoor Fan Lock. Confirmation with unit manual is mandatory.

permitted_customer_action: Reset unit via MCB. Do NOT touch indoor coil sensors.
technician_action: Measure middle pipe thermistor resistance (typically 5kΩ or 10kΩ at 25°C).

permitted_customer_action: Reset AC via MCB for 3 minutes. If problem persists, book technician.
technician_action: Check outlet pipe sensor connection and resistance. Ensure sensor is seated correctly on U-bend.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC at MCB breaker immediately. High voltage hazard. Do NOT restart. Book authorized technician.
technician_action: Check compressor winding resistance. Test IPM module on outdoor PCB. Check refrigerant charge. Verify no mechanical lock in compressor.

permitted_customer_action: Reset system once via MCB. If error returns, turn off and book service.
technician_action: Check CT sensor connection on outdoor PCB. Measure current draw vs rated amps. Replace CT or PCB if faulty.

permitted_customer_action: Check household voltage stability. If line voltage is below 190V, use an approved AC voltage stabilizer. Do not tamper with wiring.
technician_action: Measure input AC voltage. Check rectifier bridge and smoothing capacitors on outdoor PCB. Verify compressor not drawing excessive current.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC. Ensure outdoor unit is not blocked by objects. Clean condenser fins if safely accessible without opening.
technician_action: Check condenser cleanliness. Verify fan operation. Measure discharge pressure. Check high-pressure switch continuity. Verify refrigerant charge.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC immediately. Do NOT retry power. Book urgent technician visit.
technician_action: Check compressor terminals U-V-W resistance. Test start/run capacitor. Check for mechanical seizure. Verify PCB output to compressor.

permitted_customer_action: Reset via MCB breaker once. If code returns, do not use unit.
technician_action: Check PFC reactor connections. Test PFC diode and MOSFET on outdoor PCB. Verify input voltage waveform.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC. If electrical repairs were recently conducted in the home, phases may have reversed.
technician_action: For 3-phase models: Swap any two input phase wires. For single-phase: Check compressor wiring sequence and capacitor.

permitted_customer_action: Ensure outdoor condensing unit is not obstructed. Allow unit to cool down for 20 minutes before restarting.
technician_action: Check condenser cleanliness. Verify refrigerant charge (low gas causes high discharge temp). Test discharge sensor accuracy.

permitted_customer_action: Reset system. Schedule service if error continues.
technician_action: Check outdoor pipe sensor connection and resistance. Verify sensor placement on condenser coil.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC to prevent compressor cavitation. Book technician visit for pressure sensor and gas inspection.
technician_action: Check low pressure sensor switch continuity and refrigerant operating pressure.
note: Referenced in AC03 tree; absent from official error code lookup. Requires model-specific confirmation.

permitted_customer_action: CH 38 indicates low refrigerant gas. Stop operating the AC in cooling mode to protect the compressor. Schedule gas leak detection and refill with certified technician.
technician_action: Conduct nitrogen pressure test to locate leak, repair flare joints, pull vacuum (<500 microns), recharge R32 to exact weight.
note: Common LG Dual Inverter symptom code. In AC03 tree; absent from lg_ac_error_codes.json. Requires verification.

permitted_customer_action: Reset AC. Service needed if persistent.
technician_action: Test ambient sensor resistance. Check PCB connector. Replace sensor if out of spec.

permitted_customer_action: Reset AC via breaker. If persists, book technician for sensor testing.
technician_action: Measure discharge thermistor resistance (typically 200kΩ at 25°C).

permitted_customer_action: Reset system via MCB breaker.
technician_action: Check discharge sensor clip on compressor top. Measure resistance. Replace if open/short.

permitted_customer_action: Reset AC. Book service if unresolved.
technician_action: Locate mid-condenser sensor. Test resistance and connection integrity.

permitted_customer_action: Reset system via MCB for 3 minutes.
technician_action: Check suction pipe sensor attachment. Measure resistance. Verify no moisture ingress in connector.

permitted_customer_action: Power cycle system via MCB breaker. If persists, professional technician servicing is required.
technician_action: Re-flash outdoor PCB firmware if supported. Otherwise replace outdoor main PCB.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC for 30 minutes. Check for blocked outdoor unit airflow. Clear debris away from outdoor fan grille.
technician_action: Check condenser blockage. Measure running amps. Verify refrigerant charge. Check ambient temperature conditions.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC for 20 minutes to allow condenser to cool. Ensure clearance around outdoor unit.
technician_action: Clean condenser coil with low pressure water and inspect outdoor fan motor.

permitted_customer_action: Turn off AC immediately. Inverter heatsink overheating requires inspection.
technician_action: Check thermal paste between IPM and heatsink. Inspect heatsink fan ventilation.

permitted_customer_action: Ensure outdoor unit has proper ventilation. Turn off for 20 minutes before restarting.
technician_action: Check heatsink thermal paste application. Verify fan speed. Clean heatsink fins. Check IPM mounting torque.

permitted_customer_action: Stop using AC. Outdoor BLDC motor position error. Authorized service only.
technician_action: Check compressor terminal connections. Test IPM output. Verify compressor/motor not mechanically locked.

permitted_customer_action: This code appears during commissioning or test run mode. Contact your installer to complete the setup process.
technician_action: Complete auto-addressing procedure. Verify DIP switches. Run commissioning test mode per service manual.
